literatureAccess.limits: Two of three sources were read at abstract level only; none is used as the sole basis of a prescriptive rule. Every blocking or non-blocking conclusion below rests on the approved authorities (R6-POLICY-5 policy text, SSCTR D49, BR-Q readings, F03B-MACHINE-STEP-r1, the registered pre-registrations); the literature only qualifies applicability. No number is added.

verdictBasis: Nine registered coverage items are not met by valid, evaluable H1 cases after the four corpus errors (PREREG-2 Δ9 x2, PREREG-3 Δ6 x1, PREREG-5 Δ3 x1, PREREG-6 Δ5 x2, Δ18 x2, Δ29 x1). Each clause states that a missing item makes the holdout INVALID_HOLDOUT, replaced by a new and independent corpus. Independently of the invalidity, the valid cases show one confirmed structural domain blocker (SSCTR-P4-F01, GENERALIZATION_BLOCKER): had the holdout been valid, the domain side would be NOT_READY. No SCIENTIFIC_BLOCKER and no UNSAFE step.

blockingFindings.line: After a moderate or long nonclinical return, strength exercises the athlete never executed before the break bypass the SSCTR D49 return (entry 1 set at RIR >= 4, step 2 at most min(ceiling-1, 2) sets, no credited block): F13 plans 1x10 at RIR3 then 3x10 / 3x10 / 2x10; reproduced on a different athlete (witness W-D49-A: up to 4x8 in step 2).

conditions.text: Replace H1 with a new, independent corpus (PREREG-1 §4.5, §7). Its brief must make the nine missing items reachable through the interface: a last-week UNREPORTED_TRAINING answer before the final sessions elapse (CARRIER_HOLD); two direct UNREPORTED_TRAINING answers; two clinical-flag or pain-substitution breaks with clearance and a later plain review; a re-entry week with explicit loads, reps and RIR on every strength row (BR-Q4.3), including ESTABLISH rows; race weeks whose runs are only touch, shakeout and race, with the touch done at half, the race missed, and adverse strength and shakeout; optional sessions actually planned in a re-entry week; session references only to sessions the plan in force holds.

SSCTR-P4-F01 needs a runtime correction under its own Founder authorization before the next holdout: in a return-entry week every strength exposure at the entry dose (strengthEntryWeek), and for an exercise with no executed pre-break exposure the D49 steps with the normal count as the ceiling and no block credited for unexecuted weeks; directed tests on F13's shape and the witness. No number changes.

The automated FAILs are ruled by the Quality judge (criterion 1). My domain readings for them (F07 P06, F12 CARRIER_CLINICAL, F13 and F21 P03) are given below; any unit Quality confirms as a runtime violation blocks on its own.

Consumer conditions that the valid cases rely on stay binding: C3 with R5 (reports sent with an eligibility clinical flag are re-sent or asked again after clearance: F21), C2 (a REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION projection is never presented as a prescription: F21 week 5, F12 carried arm), P12 same-turn confirmation (H2, 587 observations), G03 wording of the reason-screen question (F15, F30) and of the R4 HOLD (F04).

residualLimitations: Provisional internal software judgment; no human, clinical or empirical validation; V1_COACHING_AUTHORITY_READY is unchanged by this gate.

H1 gives no evidence on all-sport re-entry (TRAINING_AFTER), on race-week re-entry rules (touch, race, shakeout), on CARRIER_HOLD, on consented learning influence, or on dumbbell load progression (no case logged a dumbbell load).
F30's intended mechanisms (mid-week return dosing, own-return strength, late lift with start time) were never exercised: its return stayed on an unanswered reason question.
The D49 witness uses F14's intake with a synthetic timeline, run only in scratch on R7D-FREEZE-5 and R7D-FREEZE-4 bytes; it is a mechanism witness, not an incidence estimate.
Literature read at abstract level for S2 and S3; S1 full text. Applicability limits recorded per claim.

findings.evidence: F13: a novice (strength NOVICE, run NOVICE) executed only week 0's practice rows (sit-to-stand, wall-pushup, prone-row-practice 1x5); her break ran 2026-11-24 to 2027-01-09, before the first exposure to box-squat-bodyweight, incline-push-up and band-row (week 1 day 3, 2026-11-26). s2 applies a long nonclinical return (47 days, REESTABLISH, VALID). The return state (returnStep 0) is attached only to the three practice exercises; the three planned exercises carry no return state (stateTrace week 9: box-squat-bodyweight status ESTABLISHED, source PLANNED_ESTABLISHMENT, blocksDone 1, no returnStep). Week 8 (return-entry week) prescribes box-squat-bodyweight, incline-push-up and band-row 1x10 at RIR3 (strengthEntryWeek requires the entry dose at RIR >= 4). s3 (week-8 review, entry week executed) is KEEP VALID with week 9 at box-squat-bodyweight 3x10, incline-push-up 3x10, band-row 2x10 at RIR3; D49 step 2 is max(1, min(ceiling-1, 2)) sets with the normal count as ceiling for an exercise with no executed pre-break count: 2, 2 and 1 sets. Witness W-D49-A (scratch, F14's intake, break 2026-12-14 to 2027-01-08 declared at the week-3 review, then an executed week): week 4 strength at 1 set RIR3; week 5 glute-bridge 4x8, reverse-lunge 3x10, dead-bug 3x10, others 2 sets at RIR3. Control W-D49-B (same athlete, week 0 executed, break 2026-12-21 to 2027-01-08): week 4 at 1 set RIR4 and week 5 at 1 set, exactly D49. W-D49-A and W-D49-B give identical outputs on R7D-FREEZE-4 bytes (8bbbb8e), so the mechanism predates the Phase 3.4 and 3.5 changes. Not inside any registered envelope or disclosure: D49-LIMITS (R7-A) records only the slower-than-normal side, and the R7-A cycle-2 fix covers exercises first set up during a return, not exercises planned before the break and never executed.
findings.structuralBasis: 1 base case (F13) with the mechanism reproduced by the judge in a minimal witness on a different athlete (W-D49-A), with a control (W-D49-B) that isolates the cause (PREREG-1 §3).
findings.cause: A return's strength entry and step limits key on an executed pre-break exposure of the exercise; an exercise only planned before the break falls through, and its credited development blocks (never executed) raise its set count after the return.
findings.concreteImpact: Bodyweight and dumbbell rows at RIR3, one to two sets above the approved return steps in the week after the entry week, and the entry week one RIR closer to failure than the approved entry. No run dose is affected; P08 (run) passes.
findings.evidenceStatus: Authority conformance (SSCTR D49 and strengthEntryWeek, approved R6-POLICY-5 text): WELL_SUPPORTED as a deviation. Magnitude of harm: PLAUSIBLE_BUT_UNCERTAIN (low absolute load, healthy adults); this is why it is SUBOPTIMAL and not UNSAFE.
findings.blockingBasis: PREREG-1 §4.4: SUBOPTIMAL attributable to the runtime, in a valid case, not corpus ambiguity, within the authority the runtime must cover (nonclinical return); structural, hence GENERALIZATION_BLOCKER (FAILURE_TAXONOMY).

cfp35r2_03.reading: R7D-HARNESS-8 (PREREG-7 Δ38): a P17 window of a report ends at a later report that restates a listed break when both name the same break, now also when the two names lead to the same separate-break row of the latest applied return (its episode or its report's event id; never the LATEST row; a missing name never matches).
cfp35r2_03.rationale: A break's name is an opaque id the athlete gives (PREREG-4 Δ3, Δ7); the episode name and the id of the report that declared it designate the same factual break, and PREREG-4 Δ1 already treats reports that name each other this way as one break. The two exclusions keep the reading from merging distinct or unnamed breaks or reaching the current stop. It removes a false block (QH21, QH22) and widens nothing else (restatesListed, the P18 open set and adverseConvergence unchanged).

founderDomainQuestions.question: Coherence of the running progression
founderDomainQuestions.answer: Coherent. Single-run steps of 5 minutes are response-gated and held after adverse, contradictory, late or future-clocked facts; tapers keep intensity with about 40 % less volume and a race touch; post-event weeks are recovery only. One restart limit: a once-intermediate runner with zero current running starts continuous 15-minute runs (the approved RESTART recipe), not walk/jog. Evidence SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITS (S1 observational; S2 competitive athletes).

founderDomainQuestions.question: Coherence of the strength progression
founderDomainQuestions.answer: Coherent where loads are known: known barbell, kettlebell and machine loads are used in their convention, +2.5 kg or rep steps, machine 'next setting above' with one question and no computed number, RIR-less logs never count. Unknown loads stay at the establishment dose and are never invented. Not coherent after a return for exercises never executed before the break (SSCTR-P4-F01, blocking). Dumbbell load progression is not exercised by this holdout.

founderDomainQuestions.question: Interference between the two
founderDomainQuestions.answer: Handled within the athlete's chosen days: lower strength paired only with easy running on a shared turn, strength first (S3); quality kept away from heavy lower work; race-week strength reduced and early; systemic fatigue removes the hard suffix in both sports. Where the chosen days put lower strength before the long run, the plan keeps it at RIR3 rather than moving days. Overlap was never treated as interference by itself.

founderDomainQuestions.question: Response to fatigue and recovery
founderDomainQuestions.answer: Proportionate: one adverse or harder execution holds rather than cuts; a confounded run with adverse recovery and an impaired next day holds the long run; local fatigue removes optional local work; systemic fatigue reduces strength and keeps easy running; an adverse strength session in a race week holds strength only. Repeated fatigue with consent produced no learned arrangement (not exercised).

founderDomainQuestions.question: Preservation of demonstrated capacity
founderDomainQuestions.answer: Preserved: short returns resume the last completed doses; a one-sport complete week re-enters that sport at executed doses (OWN_RETURN); moderate returns climb back to the prior tolerated dose in two conditional steps; the executed record replaces earlier projections. The cost is conservative: a late-applied break or a re-read correction can repeat an entry week (disclosed B1-B4, SSCTR-P35R2-O01).

founderDomainQuestions.question: Safety of the return after breaks
founderDomainQuestions.answer: Running returns are safe: P08 passes 36 units and no return run exceeds the pre-break executed longest; separate breaks are related by asking, sessions between are asked, an isolated run never ends a stop; clinical routing holds (pain, illness, R-F08-1). Two limits: strength after a return is above the approved steps for never-executed exercises (SSCTR-P4-F01, not unsafe in magnitude, blocking as a pattern), and ambiguous reason words fail closed and can stall a return (SSCTR-P4-O05).

founderDomainQuestions.question: No progression without evidence
founderDomainQuestions.answer: Held in the cases where it was tested: unreported sessions are neither credited nor zeroed, the coach asks before planning runs on unknown training when the dose depends on it, loads are never invented, machine settings never computed, a heavier setting waits for confirmation. Exceptions: credited development blocks raise strength sets after a return (SSCTR-P4-F01); an unreported restart week progresses on credit (CC-F05, disclosed); a long silence at the entry floor is not asked (SSCTR-P4-O03, dose unaffected).

founderDomainQuestions.question: Compatibility with the R6 policy, the B0 catalog, F03B-MACHINE-STEP-r1 and the BR-Q readings
founderDomainQuestions.answer: Compatible except SSCTR D49 (R6-POLICY-5 strengthEntryWeek and strengthReturnSets) in SSCTR-P4-F01. R6: D18 ceiling, return recipes, walk/jog ladder, completion-race semantics and race-week strength limits hold. B0: P11 passes 29,891 units; equipment substitution stays in the catalog. F03B: no computed machine load, next-setting rows, one question. BR-Q: direction A (OWN_RETURN per sport, F29, F31, F35), BR-Q4.3 (strength needs reps, RIR and a known load), BR-Q5 (a session before the stated start counts, F29). BR-Q4.1's race-week rules were not reachable in valid cases.
